lines.en: Croak, jump high!
This territory's mine!
Feel my tongue!
Jumping is my forte!
Don't let my saliva touch you!
Find more prey!
Larger jumps carry me high!
My size is perfect for riding!
Devour all, it's my duty!
Be wary of my big mouth!
My hind legs kick and I clear the bush.
Mud splashes when I land.

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷走路边的虫。
lines.en: My tongue sweeps up a bug by the path.
Belly to the ground, I slide a stretch.
I hop once, then pause.

lines.zh: 我每一步都压得草叶伏倒。
lines.en: Every step of mine flattens the grass.

lines.zh: 我侧身挤过狭窄的石缝。
lines.en: I squeeze sideways through a narrow gap.
The saddle on my back wobbles.
I hop toward the sound of water.
My tongue flicks out and back.

lines.zh: 我蹲在泥里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: Squatting in the mud, only my eyes show.
Wait for prey!
Enjoy my silence!

lines.zh: 我蹲在泥边，喉咙一鼓一鼓。
lines.en: I squat at the mud's edge, throat pulsing.
Be patient for the right moment!
My patience is endless!
I am the ruler here!
Wait for prey to fall into my trap!
Enjoy this quiet moment!
Wait for the perfect jump!
I squat with my throat puffing.
I half-close my eyes in the sun.

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经贴在嘴边。
lines.en: My tongue rests against my lips.
Player, come closer!
Watch my move!
You're just about one mouthful.
Don't move, I'm catching you!
Feel my saliva!
You're my target!
This mouth is big enough for you.
My mouth is full of sticky spit.
I'm coming, feel my power!
Gooop, ow!

lines.zh: 我的唾液淌了一地，黏糊糊的。
lines.en: My saliva puddles on the ground, sticky.

lines.zh: 黏液从我嘴里流个不停。
lines.en: Slime keeps pouring from my mouth.
Rumble... hurts...

lines.zh: 呱…这身肥肉也撑不住了…
lines.en: Croak... even all this blubber can't hold on...
Save me!
My belly has flipped skyward.
Don't put me down...
Treat me...
Croak! That one really hurt.

lines.zh: 肥硕身躯引诱你靠近，但别靠近!
lines.en: Lure you in with my bulk, but stay back!

lines.zh: 我体内装满美味，但别想尝一口!
lines.en: My belly is full of treats, but don't try!

lines.zh: 小心我的大嘴巴，会吞掉你!
lines.en: Watch out for my big mouth, it's hungry!

lines.zh: 唾液黏腻，是上好的命名牌材料!
lines.en: My saliva is perfect for name tags!

lines.zh: 你无法抵抗我的诱惑，但别靠近!
lines.en: You can't resist me, but stay away!

lines.zh: 我巨大到能骑，但只听‘串肉’令!
lines.en: I'm huge, but only respond to 'chops'!

lines.zh: 我的跳跃高度随体型而异!
lines.en: My jump height varies with my size!
Don't underestimate me, I'm a big eater!

lines.zh: 我的叫声是警告你远离!
lines.en: My call warns you to stay away!

lines.zh: 我栖息于稀树草原，快别靠近!
lines.en: I live in the savanna, stay away!
Collision angers me!

lines.zh: 你撞到了我，现在尝尝我的牙!
lines.en: You bumped me, taste my teeth now!

lines.zh: 我体型巨大，你的碰撞无关紧要!
lines.en: My size makes your bumpings insignificant!

lines.zh: 小心，我可能因碰撞发怒!
lines.en: Be careful, I may rage from your bump!
My jump height scares you!

lines.zh: 我的叫声会因碰撞而改变!
lines.en: My call changes with your bump!

lines.zh: 我栖息地的环境让你避开!
lines.en: My habitat makes you avoid!

lines.zh: 你的碰撞引发我的攻击!
lines.en: Your bump triggers my attack!

lines.zh: 我巨大到能吞下你，小心!
lines.en: I'm big enough to swallow you, beware!
My wings can push you away!
Finding a mate is my task!

lines.zh: 求偶季节，我的叫声更响!
lines.en: Mating season makes my call louder!
I attract partners with my call!

lines.zh: 我的叫声传递求偶信息!
lines.en: My call signals mating!

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上有求偶信息!
lines.en: My wings carry mating info!
I need time to choose a mate!
My mating call guides partners!
My habitat suits mating!

lines.zh: 我的求偶叫声招来伴侣!
lines.en: My mating call attracts partners!
My call is a mating signal!

lines.zh: 呱呱叫，肥硕体，肉质鲜，骑乘宝。
lines.en: Quack! Fat and juicy, perfect to ride.

lines.zh: 跳跃间，身躯大，肉串控，方向准。
lines.en: Jump high, controlled by meat skewers.

lines.zh: 捕食时，唾液多，命名牌，唾液造。
lines.en: Lots of saliva for name tags.

lines.zh: 捕食中，食量大，小动物，都吞下。
lines.en: Devours small creatures, enormous appetite.

lines.zh: 巨蛙体，飞行中，肉串引，方向定。
lines.en: Large frog, use meat to steer.

lines.zh: 呱呱叫，跳跃高，个体异，各不同。
lines.en: Quack! Jump height varies by individual.

lines.zh: 巨型蛙，食肉兽，捕食间，声震林。
lines.en: Giant frog, roars during hunting.

lines.zh: 栖息地，白垩林，巨大蛙，独行侠。
lines.en: Habitat: Cretaceous forest, solitary giant frog.

lines.zh: 吞食后，多余液，命名牌，唾液制。
lines.en: Extra saliva for name tags.

lines.zh: 飞行时，肉串牵，方向稳，控制佳。
lines.en: Flight guided by meat skewers.

lines.zh: 猎物近，呱呱叫，锁定它，吞食掉。
lines.en: Target detected, quack and eat it.

lines.zh: 肉串绕，锁定准，呱呱叫，吞下它。
lines.en: Skewer target, quack and devour.

lines.zh: 体型大，视线清，锁定猎，一口吞。
lines.en: Large body, clear sight, lock and eat.

lines.zh: 猎物动，锁定它，呱呱叫，吞食掉。
lines.en: Target moves, quack and eat.

lines.zh: 周围动，锁定它，呱呱叫，吞食掉。
lines.en: Surrounding movement, quack and eat.

lines.zh: 目标现，锁定它，呱呱叫，吞食掉。
lines.en: Target appears, quack and eat.

lines.zh: 锁定它，呱呱叫，吞食掉，巨蛙行。
lines.en: Lock and quack, devour, giant frog.

lines.zh: 锁定猎，呱呱叫，吞食掉，无误吞。
lines.en: Target locked, quack and devour accurately.

lines.zh: 锁定中，呱呱叫，吞食掉，巨蛙威。
lines.en: Locked, quack and devour, giant frog strength.

lines.zh: 锁定它，呱呱叫，吞食掉，巨蛙威。
lines.en: Lock and quack, devour, giant frog power.

lines.zh: 锁定它，呱呱叫，方向明，吞食掉。
lines.en: Lock, quack and steer, then eat.

lines.zh: 锁定猎，呱呱叫，肉串引，吞食掉。
lines.en: Lock target, quack, use skewers, then eat.

lines.zh: 锁定后，呱呱叫，吞食掉，巨蛙行。
lines.en: Locked, quack and eat, giant frog.

lines.zh: 锁定它，呱呱叫，吞食掉，方向稳。
lines.en: Lock, quack, eat, direction steady.

lines.zh: 锁定猎，呱呱叫，吞食掉，巨蛙行。
lines.en: Lock, quack, eat, giant frog.

lines.zh: 锁定它，呱呱叫，吞食掉，巨蛙威
lines.en: Lock, quack, eat, giant frog strength

lines.zh: 锁定后，呱呱叫，吞食掉，方向明。
lines.en: Locked, quack and eat, direction clear.

lines.zh: 锁定它，呱呱叫，吞食掉，巨蛙行
lines.en: Lock, quack and eat, giant frog
I lower my body, ready to launch.

lines.zh: 我的舌头在嘴边探了探。
lines.en: My tongue tests the air by my mouth.
Meat on a stick, stick gets you!
Hop, big frog!
Nom nom nom!
Goo! Dinner!
Jump scare!
Slobbery spit makes name tags!
Big frog anger!
Eat all, big frog might!
Jump 'em off!

lines.zh: 我的舌头卷住你的腿往回拖！
lines.en: My tongue wraps your leg and drags you back!
Goo! New buddy!
Cretaceous gift!
Pop out of the ground!
Ancient frog appears!
Big frog falls from sky!
Awake, goo!

lines.zh: 我从泥浆里拱出来，水花四溅。
lines.en: I heave out of the muck, splashing everywhere.
Dinosaur-era giant frog!
Cave, here I am!
New Cretaceous resident!

lines.zh: 泥潭里冒出我的一对眼睛。
lines.en: My pair of eyes surfaces in the mud pool.
I push out from under the fern fronds.
With a splash I leap ashore.

lines.zh: 我压得草丛塌下去一块。
lines.en: I press a patch of grass down flat.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤一碰火就干了。
lines.en: My skin dries the moment fire touches it.
Ah! Fell down!
Help! So cold in the water...
Boom! Exploded...

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的腿，我跳不动了。
lines.en: An arrow takes my leg; I can't leap.
Magic! So painful...
So hungry...
Lightning! Oh...
Ah! Fell into the void...
